faq.headline: Beauty Salon Website FAQs
faq.description: Clear answers to help you plan and publish your salon site.

items.question: How do I make a website for my salon?
items.answer: Start with the details clients need: services, salon hours, location, team, examples of your work, and a way to contact you. Velozy uses your business profile and page plan to generate a starting point you can review and edit.

items.question: Can I show salon services and prices?
items.answer: Yes. You can create service sections with descriptions and prices that you provide, then review and update them in the site editor.

items.question: Can clients book appointments on the website?
items.answer: A contact or enquiry form can collect appointment requests. Online appointment scheduling depends on the bookings module being available for your account and site.

items.question: Can I add photos of my salon and work?
items.answer: Yes. Add images of your space, team, and work to help visitors understand the style of your salon. Use images you have permission to publish.

items.question: Can I publish a salon website for free?
items.answer: The Free plan includes one published homepage on a Velozy subdomain. Additional pages and custom domains require a paid plan. Check the current pricing page for plan details.

items.question: Will my salon website work on phones?
items.answer: Velozy generates responsive websites designed to adapt to phone, tablet, and desktop screens. Review the preview at each size before publishing.
